title: What Being Passed Over Is Doing to a Godly Man (It's Not a Punishment)
caption:
Being passed over stings. It also shows you who you were really working for.

A godly man lets it expose the heat, remembers the cell and the sheep, keeps working like it's watched, and congratulates the man who got it.

What's one thing you can do quietly this week?

#faith #godlymen #christianman #humility #work #scripture
